Knowledge facts: part C holds 38 fact blocks (sec03-F01 onward) from physical pages 20 to 23; part C2 holds 16 confusable and continuation blocks (sec03-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A states the issuer, the Revised August 2026 guide, the 25-question written test and the passing standard of 20 correct answers (80 percent) from physical pages 1, 3, 4 and 20; the time limit is unknown.
VERIFY list:
- MO-EXAM-A-TIME — written-test time limit not printed in the guide (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- MO-EXAM-D-SIGNTEST — road sign test item count and pass mark not stated (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- MO-EXAM-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- MO-EXAM-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: testing center locations and the Highway Patrol website address (for example sec03-F05 and sec03-R16) can change and must be refreshed from the MSHP and Department of Revenue websites.
